hook.en: After closing, you sneak his file back into the law-library archive. The student-body president was watching from the mezzanine.
hook.zh: 闭馆后，你偷偷把他的档案放回法学院档案箱。学生会主席一直在夹层上看着你。

options.en: Tell him the truth: someone is setting him up.
'Report me, then. I'll tell the board what's in it.'
options.zh: “那你举报啊，我就告诉理事会里面写了什么”

options.en: Snatch the file and run for the spiral stair.
options.zh: 抢回档案，往旋转楼梯跑

caps.en: Archive closes at ten. You're on my camera at twelve-fifty.
caps.zh: 档案室十点就关了。十二点五十，你出现在我的监控里。

caps.en: I was just returning a book.
caps.zh: 我只是来还一本书。

caps.en: You were returning my file.
caps.zh: 你是来还我的档案。

caps.en: I could report you tonight. Or you tell me who sent you.
caps.zh: 我今晚就能举报你。或者，你告诉我是谁派你来的。

caps.en: You wouldn't believe me.
caps.zh: 说了你也不会信。

caps.en: You have until I put this back.
caps.zh: 在我把它放回去之前，你想清楚。

hook.en: You benched the hockey captain in the final. Now he's cornered you in the tunnel - and wants his medic to clear him for one drink.
hook.zh: 决赛里你把冰球队长按上了替补席。现在他把你堵在通道里——要他的队医批准他去喝一杯。

options.en: Sign his clearance - and write your number under it.
options.zh: 签字放行——再把电话号码写在下面

options.en: Click the penlight on: 'Follow the light first, captain.'
options.zh: 打开笔灯：“先跟着光走一遍，队长。”

options.en: Take the clipboard back and walk past him to the exit.
options.zh: 拿回夹板，从他身边走向出口

caps.en: You benched me in the third period.
caps.zh: 第三节你把我按在了替补席上。

caps.en: You failed the concussion check.
caps.zh: 你脑震荡检查没过。

caps.en: Ask me anything. Name. Date... your number.
caps.zh: 随便问。名字。日期……你的电话。

caps.en: Your pulse is faster than mine, doc.
caps.zh: 你的心跳比我还快，医生。

caps.en: It's cold in here.
caps.zh: 这里冷。

caps.en: Team's at the bar. I'm not going.
caps.zh: 队友都去酒吧了。我不去。

caps.en: Unless my medic clears me... for one drink.
caps.zh: 除非我的队医批准我……喝一杯。

hook.en: You're the auditor who found the family's second ledger. The heir comes down to the cellar - his father wants you gone, and he wants to know whose side you're on.
hook.zh: 你是查出家族第二本账的审计师。继承人走下酒窖——他父亲要你消失，而他想知道你站在谁那边。

options.en: Take the glass: 'For you. But the ledger stays with me.'
options.zh: 接过酒杯：“替你。但账本归我。”

options.en: 'I work for whoever keeps me alive.'
Ask what happened to the last auditor.
options.zh: 问他：上一个审计师怎么样了

caps.en: Most people who find that book leave through the back door.
caps.zh: 找到那本账的人，大多是从后门被抬出去的。

caps.en: I'm not leaving without it.
caps.zh: 不带上它，我不走。

caps.en: You're still here. You wanted me to find you.
caps.zh: 你还没走。你是想让我找到你。

caps.en: My father wants you gone by morning. I said I'd handle it.
caps.zh: 我父亲要你天亮前消失。我说，交给我处理。

caps.en: Handle me how?
caps.zh: 怎么处理我？

caps.en: So. Do you work for him, or for me?
caps.zh: 所以，你是替他做事，还是替我？

hook.en: The power dies at the top of the tower. Your new bodyguard smothers your light, pulls you down, and counts the men coming for you.
hook.zh: 顶层公寓突然断电。新来的保镖捂灭你的手电，把你按到沙发后面，数着来抓你的人。

tags: close-protection officer, cold outside, warm inside

options.en: Grab his collar: 'I'm not leaving without you.'
options.zh: 揪住他的衣领：“没有你我不走。”

options.en: Press the keycard back into his hand: 'Then you run. I'll count.'
options.zh: 把门卡塞回他手里：“那你跑，我来数。”

options.en: Hold on to his wrist: 'They're not here for me. They're here for you.'
options.zh: 抓住他的手腕：“他们不是冲我来的，是冲你。”

caps.en: Don't. They're watching the windows.
caps.zh: 别开。他们在盯着窗户。

caps.en: Who's out there?
caps.zh: 外面是谁？

caps.en: Two on the stairs. One in the lift.
caps.zh: 楼梯上两个，电梯里一个。

caps.en: Service door, end of the hall. Count to thirty, then run.
caps.zh: 走廊尽头的员工通道。数到三十，然后跑。

caps.en: What about you?
caps.zh: 那你呢？

caps.en: If I'm not behind you by thirty, don't come back for me.
caps.zh: 数到三十我还没跟上来，就别回来找我。

hook.en: Your ex texted at 11:42 last night. Your boyfriend of three years read every word - and now he wants to watch you answer.
hook.zh: 前任昨晚 11:42 发来消息。交往三年的男友一个字不落全看完了——现在他要看着你回。

tags: easygoing boyfriend who is quietly serious

options.en: Type it while he watches: 'I'm happy. Don't text me again.'
options.zh: 当着他的面打字：“我很好，别再联系我。”

options.en: Put the phone in his hand: 'You read it all. You answer him.'
options.zh: 把手机塞回他手里：“你都看完了，你来回。”

options.en: 'He's not texting about us, Noah. It's about my sister.'
options.zh: “他发消息不是为了我们，Noah。是因为我妹妹。”

caps.en: You still have him saved as 'Home'.
caps.zh: 你还把他存成“家”。

caps.en: I didn't answer him.
caps.zh: 我没回他。

caps.en: I know. I read the whole thread.
caps.zh: 我知道。整段聊天我都看完了。

caps.en: Three years. I've never once asked for your password.
caps.zh: 三年了。我一次都没问过你的密码。

caps.en: So answer him. Right now. While I watch.
caps.zh: 那就回他。现在。当着我的面。

hook.en: The CEO who just bought your company stopped the elevator. He wants ten minutes - and you.
hook.zh: 刚收购你公司的 CEO 让电梯停了。他要十分钟——还要你。

tags: rival CEO who just acquired her firm
cold, in control, cares more than he admits

options.en: Take the pen and sign - then name your price.
options.zh: 接过笔签字——然后开你的价

options.en: Tear the contract in half in front of him.
options.zh: 当着他的面把合同撕成两半

options.en: Push the pen back: 'Why me, Julian?'
options.zh: 把笔推回去：“为什么是我，Julian？”

caps.en: Don't bother. I had maintenance stop it.
caps.zh: 别按了。是我让维修停的。

caps.en: You did what?
caps.zh: 你干了什么？

caps.en: Ten minutes. You've avoided me for six weeks.
caps.zh: 十分钟。你躲了我六个星期。

caps.en: Be my head of strategy. Or clear out your desk.
caps.zh: 来当我的战略总监。要么收拾桌子走人。

caps.en: You could have emailed.
caps.zh: 你发封邮件就行了。

caps.en: I'd rather you hate me from the office next door.
caps.zh: 我宁可你在隔壁办公室恨我。
